title: perf: cross-batch dequant fusion with amortized per-token rescale for mixed-precision kernels
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Long-context workloads show fragmentation across microbatches that prevent effective dequant fusion and cause repeated dequant/rescale operations per token. This PR introduces a cross-batch dequant fusion pass plus an amortized per-token rescale step that cooperates with the KV cache and continuous batching coordinator to reduce redundant dequant work for INT8/FP8 mixed-precision serving.

Summary of changes: implemented a new CrossBatchDequanter that tracks compatible contiguous microbatch windows and emits a fused dequant operation for stacked tokens; added an AmortizedRescale operator that defers fine-grained scale adjustments until token groups exceed a stability threshold; extended the scheduler with a cross-batch affinity hint and modified the KV cache interface to expose per-layer scale metadata needed by the fused path. Also added kernel-level fastpaths for fused int8->fp16 conversion targeting long prefix reuse patterns.

Design notes: the fused path is opt-in behind a runtime feature flag (RUNTIME_FUSED_DEQUANT). When enabled the scheduler annotates queued requests with batch-affinity tags; CrossBatchDequanter periodically probes the queue to form mergeable windows constrained by latency SLO heuristics. AmortizedRescale computes a combined scale factor and only applies per-token micro-adjustments when the cumulative quantization error crosses a configurable threshold (defaults tuned from benchmarks). Compatibility: falls back to existing per-request dequant for heterogeneous model variants and when KV cache indicates incompatible scale signatures.

Benchmarks: microbench on p4d.24xlarge with a 16k context evaluation harness showed up to 22% throughput improvement and 18% average token-latency reduction on customer-like chat load (95th percentile latency remained within SLO). FP8/INT8 combined workloads saw better utilization due to fewer kernel launches and improved KV cache hit patterns. Detailed numbers included in /docs/perf/crossbatch-dequant-run-2026-02-20.md.

Testing: unit tests for CrossBatchDequanter and AmortizedRescale (kernel emulation mode), end-to-end CI smoke against the runtime with synthetic traffic, and a canary rollout configuration for Dedicated. Stress tests included kv-cache warm/cold cycles and continuous-batching scenarios. CI initially reported a flaky scheduler test (test_scheduler_affinity) which was fixed by adding a deterministic queue snapshot during window formation.

Rollout plan: behind feature flag, canary on dedicated pools with low-priority routing, opt-in for private deployments via config toggle. Observability: new metrics added (dequant_fused_windows, amortized_rescale_ops, per_layer_scale_mismatch) and alerting thresholds proposed in SLO dashboard PR.

Related: follows up on ENG-3962 and complements earlier kernel fusion work (see ENG-1538). Notable tradeoffs: slightly increased memory for temporary fused buffers; however the overall token compute/launch overhead drops substantially for long prefix reuse.

Files changed (high level): runtime/kernel/crossbatch_dequant.cc, runtime/kernel/crossbatch_dequant.h, runtime/kernel/fused_int8_fp16_path.cu, runtime/scheduler/crossbatch_coordinator.cpp, runtime/scheduler/crossbatch_coordinator.h, runtime/scheduler/affinity_hint.h, runtime/kv_cache/scale_metadata.h, runtime/kv_cache/scale_metadata.cpp, runtime/config/feature_flags.yaml, docs/perf/crossbatch-dequant-run-2026-02-20.md, tests/unit/test_crossbatch_dequant.cpp, tests/integration/test_amortized_rescale_endtoend.py and supporting mocks and CI scripts.

Commits: ["add cross-batch dequant core algorithm and API", "implement amortized per-token rescale operator", "scheduler: cross-batch affinity hint and coordinator loop", "kv_cache: expose per-layer scale metadata and compatibility checks", "kernel: fused int8->fp16 conversion fastpath (CUDA) with unit tests", "docs/perf: add benchmark run and interpretation notes", "tests: stabilize scheduler test by snapshotting queue during windowing"].

Review conversation (high level): reviewer Arjun Patel: "This is a promising direction — major nit: the window formation should account for heterogenous model variants to avoid incorrect fusion across layout changes." Author reply (Maya Chen): "Added compatibility probe and documented fallback semantics; windowing now checks per-layer signatures before merging." Reviewer Liam O'Connor: "Can we quantify memory overhead of fused buffers and add a guard to disable when memory pressure is high?" Author: "Added runtime guard and heuristic to revert to per-request dequant if free GPU memory < 6GB for the pool." Reviewer Sofia Martinez: "CI showed a flaky test — please stabilize." Author: "Fixed and added deterministic snapshot in the coordinator loop; CI green now."

Merge outcome: approved by reviewers after two iterations, CI green on final run, merged via squash.

Release notes: "Add experimental fused cross-batch dequant and amortized rescale path to improve INT8/FP8 mixed-precision throughput for long-context workloads; opt-in via RUNTIME_FUSED_DEQUANT flag. See perf docs for measured gains and rollout guidance."
